title: Stern-Gerlach Description
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately describe the Stern-Gerlach experiment and its significance in quantum theory.

title: Compton Effect Description
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately describe the Compton Effect and its contribution to quantum theory.

title: Approximate Dates
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide the correct approximate dates for both experiments.

title: Key Concepts
description: Important Criteria: The student must mention key concepts such as space quantization for Stern-Gerlach and light quanta for Compton.

title: Clarity and Conciseness
description: Optional Criteria: The response should be clear and concise, effectively communicating the main ideas without unnecessary detail.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect dates or misrepresenting the significance of the experiments.
